settings.heading: Tailored Drug & Alcohol Testing Solutions for Every Industry

settings.text:
From mining to education, we understand that every business has unique needs, which is why we offer customised drug and alcohol testing solutions designed to fit your industry.

Whether it's on-site testing, certified equipment, or personalised programs, we work to ensure your workplace stays safe, compliant, and efficient.

settings.heading: Our certified breathalysers and drug test kits provide the accuracy you need to stay safe and compliant.

settings.text: Track your employees’ breath alcohol data wherever they are located.

settings.heading: AS3570:2019 Certified Breathalysers
settings.text: Unmatched accuracy with Andatech breathalysers certified to the AS3547 standard—engineered for reliability and compliance.

settings.heading: AS4760 Verified Drug Test Kits
settings.text: Count on precise results with AS4760 verified saliva drug test kits, ensuring dependable substance testing across various environments.

settings.heading: NATA accredited Calibration Centre
settings.text: Maintain the highest level of accuracy with our NATA Accredited Calibration Centre, providing calibration services you can trust.

settings.heading: Are Andatech products and services certified and compliant with industry standards?
settings.text: Yes, all of our breathalysers and drug testing kits comply with Australian and international standards. We ensure that our devices undergo rigorous testing processes to guarantee their accuracy and reliability.

settings.heading: Can Andatech provide training for my staff on how to use the testing equipment?
settings.text: Absolutely! We offer comprehensive training sessions for your staff to ensure they are confident and competent in using our testing equipment. This training can be conducted on-site or virtually, depending on your preference.

settings.heading: What support does Andatech offer after the purchase of testing products?
settings.text:
Andatech's friendly and helpful support team are available for contact and assistance every weekday from 9AM to 5PM (AEST).

Reach out to us at support@andatech.com.au or call us at 1300-800-200 if you have any issues with your equipment.

settings.heading: What kind of warranty do Andatech products come with?
settings.text:
The Andatech Guarantee is a reflection of the confidence we have in our products.

For personal breathalysers, the Andatech Guarantee extends the standard warranty (three years) terms for up to a lifetime, for as long as the breathalyser's 6-monthly calibrations are maintained.

For workplace breathalysers, the Andatech Guarantee extends the standard warranty terms (three years) for up to 8 years on the sensor only, for as long as the breathalyser's 6-monthly calibrations are maintained.

settings.heading: Can Andatech assist with developing a comprehensive drug and alcohol policy for my workplace?
settings.text:
Absolutely! Our experts can help you create a tailored drug and alcohol policy that aligns with your company’s unique substance testing needs.

Book a call now for a free consultation!

settings.heading: What is the onboarding process like for new customers?
settings.text: Our onboarding process is straightforward and designed to ensure you get the most out of our products. After you place an order, our team will guide you through setup, training, and implementation. We also provide ongoing support to address any questions or concerns you may have.

The highest standards of breathalyser calibration available in our NATA Accredited Melbourne Calibration Centre.

Book in your breathalyser for calibration every six months to maintain the highest level of accuracy with each test.
